## Exact scope and independence

Reviewed M1 implementation commit 250b22ef against 13cb7452, its actual diff, the approved plan/Delivery r1 and current five-file Design r2, System's exact source map and m1-source-cleanup evidence. The parent authored implementation and route-owned FU-012 correction. This separately delegated reviewer authored none of those changes; prior independent Delivery assessment is not plan or implementation authorship. The current plan and all five Design r2 subjects match their approvals. Scoped context has M1 in-progress and Code Review ready, with no findings or blockers. This is a fresh milestone assessment, not final whole-change review.

The four engineering paths are the modified mixed architecture and follow-up list plus two deleted sources. Deleted ADR SHA256 before removal: 29ade42cf7eef7a4191061b6fd1c276d9d1e5ddbd16fd73e75b37742c6daf26f. Deleted diagram SHA256: 73a2b5399f1f2b69e4bbb5a7f4c5b04b2f7487839de164f442df45f5ce08b09d. Both were read completely using git show 13cb7452:path; their absence is the reviewed result, not an attempted live-subject identity. The six-path commit also includes authorized current evidence/routing records. No approval is attached to a fabricated live deletion target.

## Checklist and direct proof

| Item | Judgment | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spec alignment | pass | Exactly the two System-selected sources and three selected architecture subsections are removed; current source-list/inline references now use System, Design and Test. DES-SR-13/18/21 and SYS-SR-02/04/07 are realized without whole-spec deletion or new model creation. |
| Test coverage | pass | TG-01 compares original meaning and destinations; TG-02 checks exact boundaries, new links and history; TG-03 inspects operational identities and package inputs. No behavior/test change needs invented runtime regression proof. |
| Edge cases | pass | Mixed source obligations remain precise, candidates remain provisional, historical references remain attributable, and missing retired targets cannot be relied on as live owner links. Source/consumer recovery remains the bounded restore unit. |
| Error handling | pass | No runtime failure path is edited. The plan and current owners retain a stop for unique meaning or newly discovered actual readers; removal does not bypass recording or recovery safeguards. |
| Architecture boundaries | pass | Product-chain, target parity, release composition, deterministic record governance and semantic review remain distinct in current owners/retained R1–13/R15/16/R21/R24–29. TEST-SR-14 supplies the exact cleanup exception; SYS-DEC-04 preserves material rejected alternatives and runtime-defect treatment. |
| Compatibility | pass | Unselected architecture subsections and operational roots are unchanged. FU-012 corrects completed common Skill adoption and assigns remaining selector/preflight/cache ownership decisions without reopening the pilot or closing other follow-ups. |
| Security/privacy | pass | Documentation-only diff introduces no secret, new executable authority, publication, customer installation or weaker runtime containment. Whole-directory and unsupported behavior removal remain excluded. |
| Derived artifact currency | pass | 329 tracked operational files match baseline; operational diff from 748ff69f is empty. Package files publish dist and package metadata/README/LICENSE; adapter resources derive from canonical skills and adapter templates. Deleted descriptions are not changed package inputs; current metadata is unaffected, not a claimed newly generated package pass. |
| Unrelated changes | pass | Exact heading comparison leaves all surviving H3 bodies unchanged except the selected validation navigation paragraph; historical Follow-on artifacts is byte-identical. Only FU-012 changes in follow-ups; other records retain original identities. |
| Validation evidence | pass | Reexecuted /tmp/check-cleanup-result.py and git diff --check. Compared original sources and relevant current rules directly. Checks confirm exact removals, links, 329 unchanged operational files and no introduced prose diagnostics. Author's focused structural/prose/readability/record results are appropriately limited. |

## Semantic disposition and limitations

The removed ADR's three-target package equivalence and release-only composition have precise operational destinations in retained R4/R5/R7/R8/R28, rather than merely a generic preservation promise. Its semantic versus deterministic boundary survives in R3/R6/R11–13 and current Skill/Review and Closeout; conditional local materialization survives R9/R10. R24–29 retain proof supersessions and narrow integrity/claim constraints. The removed diagram adds no independent invariant to those relationships, and its old YAML/Markdown record label cannot revive a retired representation. SYS-DEC-04 retains the alternatives, failure knowledge and rollback rationale needed for future work. Ledger/dual-proof procedures remain with their applicable old population; Test's reviewed scoped table supplies the current cleanup exception without deleting the operational ledger fixture.

The exact source-reference searches found no executable deleted-filename consumer in scripts/packages/skills. The manual package and dependency inspection supports the scoped unaffected conclusion; no universal runtime correctness claim follows. Architecture prose remains at baseline 268 errors and 115 warnings, with no new diagnostic. Legacy template-header errors and readability advisories remain disclosed baseline debt, not hidden successful whole-file prose checks. No runtime/package/release suite was run or represented as passing in this review.

No required correction or missing necessary evidence prevents this M1 judgment. Fresh final whole-change Code Review must still inspect proposal, Design, Delivery and implementation interactions over the complete branch contribution, followed by distinct Verify. This receipt changes no work/activity state and grants no PR, publication or external-action permission.
independence_basis: Separately delegated reviewer authored no implementation, model or plan changes; previous independent Delivery judgment is not authorship. Inspected actual M1 diff, old deleted sources and current proof; writes own review only.
